# Extract residuals from an efa object

Returns the residual correlation matrix of an
[`efa_fit()`](https://mdsteiner.github.io/EFAtools/reference/efa_fit.md)
or
[`efa_mi()`](https://mdsteiner.github.io/EFAtools/reference/efa_mi.md)
solution. Residuals are a pure extractor here; their diagnostics and a
formatted display are part of
[`summary.efa()`](https://mdsteiner.github.io/EFAtools/reference/print.efa.md).

## Usage

``` r
# S3 method for class 'efa'
residuals(object, type = c("raw", "standardized"), ...)
```

## Arguments

- object:

  a list of class `efa`. Output from
  [`efa_fit()`](https://mdsteiner.github.io/EFAtools/reference/efa_fit.md)
  or
  [`efa_mi()`](https://mdsteiner.github.io/EFAtools/reference/efa_mi.md).

- type:

  character. Which residuals to return. `"raw"` (default) returns
  `orig_R - model_implied_R`; `"standardized"` returns the standardized
  residuals (residuals divided by their standard errors), available only
  when the object was fitted with bootstrap standard errors.

- ...:

  Further arguments (currently unused).

## Value

A numeric matrix of residual correlations.

## Examples

``` r
efa <- efa_fit(test_models$baseline$cormat, n_factors = 3, N = 500)
residuals(efa)
```
